recent_articles.title: Lakshmi could have been a child bride - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lakshmi**, a 16-year-old girl from Uttar Pradesh, wrote a song expressing her desire to continue her education and resist early marriage. Her father initially dismissed the message but was persuaded by **anganwadi workers** and **village pradhan**.  The village now features painted messages advocating for change in response to Lakshmi's powerful lyrics.

recent_articles.title: Bihar midday meal incident: HC asks whether NGO can continue providing meals - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Patna High Court** has expressed concern over delays in the investigation of a midday meal incident where over 150 students fell ill in Saharsa district. The court questioned whether the NGO supplying meals to over 1,800 students should continue operations during the probe and raised concerns about discrepancies in food sample collection and testing.  The court directed officials to file affidavits explaining the processes involved. The matter will be heard again on June 2nd.

recent_articles.title: Bihar cabinet approves ₹10.40 cr VGF to operate direct flight between Gaya Ji-Bangkok - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bihar** cabinet approved ₹10.40 crore in Viability Gap Funding (VGF) to support direct flights between Gaya Ji and Bangkok, with **Indigo Airlines** selected to operate the service. The funding will be provided for up to 12 months and will initially cover two weekly flights.  The decision is expected to boost international air connectivity and religious tourism by attracting Buddhist pilgrims from Thailand. Additionally, the cabinet approved ₹747.97 crore from the Bihar Contingency Fund for rural healthcare infrastructure development.

recent_articles.title: Adhikari aide killing: CBI conducts searches at multiple locations - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The CBI** conducted searches at multiple locations in connection with the murder of West Bengal Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari's aide Chandrakant Rath. The agency took over the investigation from the **West Bengal Police**, forming a seven-member special investigation team under a DIG of Special Crime from Delhi.  Rath was shot dead on May 6th, two days after the West Bengal Assembly election results were declared. Three individuals have been arrested in connection with the case, while police believe at least eight people were involved.

recent_articles.title: NIA chargesheets ‘mastermind,’ four others in Cambodia-linked ‘cyber slavery’ case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The National Investigation Agency (NIA)** filed a charge sheet against five individuals, including absconding mastermind Anand Kumar Singh, in a case of human trafficking and “cyber slavery” in Cambodia. Three accused, Abhay Nath Dubey, Rohit Yadav, and Abhiranjan Kumar, were arrested upon arrival in Delhi from Cambodia in February. The syndicate lured Indian youth to Cambodia under false pretenses for legitimate jobs and lucrative salaries. Victims were forced to work for scam companies, subjected to mental and physical torture, including electric shocks, forceful confinement, and denial of food and water.  The NIA is working to track down the remaining members of the syndicate.

recent_articles.title: One month of Samrat Choudhary Government in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Samrat Choudhary**, the leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, took office as Chief Minister of Bihar on April 15, 2026.  He has implemented several initiatives focusing on development and combating corruption, including a blueprint for 11 satellite townships across 10 districts. The government also launched the "Police Didi Scheme" to enhance women's safety, established a three-tier public support system, and approved significant funding for education and infrastructure projects. Choudhary has also introduced measures to promote transparency in private schools and prioritize local contractors on civil projects.

recent_articles.title: Nazara Technologies shares soar 18% amid reports of Nikhil Kamath upping stake in block deal - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nazara Technologies** reported a significant increase in net profit for Q4FY26, driven by lower expenses and strong revenue growth in its gaming segment. The company's founder, **Nitish Mittersain**, is selling his stake in the company, while **Nikhil Kamath** of **Zerodha** and **Axana Estates** are among potential buyers.  The company also announced plans to acquire a controlling stake in a Spanish gaming studio for $100.3 million and invest in other companies within its core business segments of gaming, esports, and ad tech.

recent_articles.title: Woman gang-raped inside bus in Delhi’s Rani Bagh, two arrested - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in Rani Bagh have arrested two bus drivers, **Umesh Kumar** and **Ramender**, for the gang-rape of a woman on a private sleeper bus. The assault occurred on May 11th after the woman refused to engage with the men following a monetary agreement.  The woman reported the incident to the police who seized the vehicle used in the crime. Both accused were apprehended within hours of the incident being reported and an FIR has been filed.

recent_articles.title: Setback for NDA as RJD wins MLC byelection in Bihar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD)** won the Bhojpur-Buxar Legislative Council seat in a byelection, defeating the **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)** candidate. **Sonu Rai**, representing the RJD, secured victory with 2,486 votes, while his opponent, **Kanhaiya Prasad** of the JD(U), received 2,146 votes. The RJD has attributed their win to alleged manipulation and fraud in the electoral process.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: India-Trinidad archival pact to help diaspora trace ancestral roots: Jaishankar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar** highlighted the importance of preserving the legacy of the **Girmitya** community during his visit to Trinidad and Tobago, emphasizing India's efforts to connect descendants with their roots.  He underscored the significance of a new archival cooperation agreement between **India** and **Trinidad and Tobago**, which aims to help individuals trace their ancestry and reconnect with families in India. The agreement, along with Prime Minister Narendra Modi's directive for a dedicated Girmitya Studies Centre, reflects India's commitment to preserving this historical legacy.  Mr. Jaishankar also noted the growing number of applications for Overseas Citizenship of India (OCI) cards following Mr. Modi's announcement of extended eligibility.

recent_articles.title: Amid Sultan Palace row, tourism minister says such heritage structures will be beautified - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kedar Prasad Gupta**, the new **Tourism Minister of Bihar**, stated that heritage buildings will be beautified in the state.  Following reports suggesting the Sultan Palace might be demolished for a five-star hotel, Mr. Gupta assured citizens that the palace would be preserved and made part of the heritage hotel project. The project was initially approved in 2024 but faced controversy after a report claimed the palace was not listed as a heritage building.  Citizens have demanded the composition of a panel investigating the palace's conservation status be made public, while some suggest listing the palace is crucial for its preservation.
